name: pokemon-showdown
description: The server for the Pokémon Showdown battle simulator

scripts.build-npm: node build && npx tsc sim/global-types.ts sim/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationDir dist/ --target es2020 --strict --moduleResolution node --types node --lib es2020
scripts.test-npm: npx tsc sim/global-types.ts sim/index.ts --noEmit --target es2020 --strict --moduleResolution node --types node --lib es2020
scripts.full-test: eslint --max-warnings 0 && npm run tsc && mocha --timeout 8000 --forbid-only -g ".*" && npm run test-npm
scripts.full-test-ci: eslint --max-warnings 0 && tsc && (([ "$SKIPSIMTESTS" = true ] && mocha --timeout 8000 --forbid-only -g ".*" --exclude "test/{sim,random-battles}/**") || mocha --timeout 8000 --forbid-only -g ".*") && npm run test-npm
